name: Furien's Post
summary: Furien's Post is a small Horde encampment stationed in the arid wastes of Desolace. Run by blood elves, the forward camp keeps watch over regional threats to the Horde while maintaining a tenuous working arrangement with the Cenarion Circle.

sections.title: An Unlikely Outpost
sections.body: Tucked away in the bleak expanses of Desolace, Furien's Post serves as a strategic vantage point for the Horde. Manned primarily by blood elf scouts and researchers, the post monitors hostile movements across the grey badlands. Though far removed from their homelands, these elves maintain vital reconnaissance for Horde leaders while navigating the delicate politics of Kalimdor's neutral factions.

sections.title: The Circle's Errand
sections.body: Beyond observing potential adversaries, the post's inhabitants hold a begrudged obligation to the Cenarion Circle. The druids requested that Furien's agents keep an eye on a researcher named Korrah working out in the wastes. While the elves find babysitting a solitary researcher beneath them, they humor the request occasionally, mindful that alienating the Cenarion Circle in such a harsh land would do the Horde no favors.

faq.answer: The outpost is manned by a detachment of blood elves loyal to the Horde, serving as scouts and researchers in central Desolace.

faq.q: What is the outpost's purpose in Desolace?
faq.answer: Its primary mission is scouting and monitoring potential adversaries that could threaten Horde interests across the barren wastes of Desolace.

faq.q: Why are blood elves helping the Cenarion Circle here?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle asked the outpost to look after Korrah, a researcher operating in the area. Though the elves care little for the chore, they check in on him periodically to maintain good relations with the druids.

faq.q: What travel connections link to Furien's Post?
aliases: how to get to furien's post
faq.answer: Couriers and wind riders link Furien's Post directly with nearby strongholds, including Sun Rock Retreat in Stonetalon, Camp Mojache in Feralas, and local Desolace hubs like Shadowprey Village and Ethel Rethor.

angles.text: Furien's Post provides vital tactical intelligence across Desolace, ensuring Horde interests are defended against rival forces while keeping neutral druidic factions satisfied.
Although the blood elves stationed here are indifferent to the Cenarion Circle's mission, their periodic oversight keeps researcher Korrah safe from the wasteland's hazards.
